test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2ba7870537df90eb2fc6e69861d10695a5d09f0552d998aa1fe764b8954b99f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

All the elements shift clockwise.

Center element is replaced by new element subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/993dfee2e9dcc11bb4df14790cfd11382ba9998557888ae44b5a11a7651785d7.png] 

2) Second box series →

2nd column elements shift to the 3rd column.

2nd and 3rd element of third column shift to the 2nd column diagonally.

Rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d0f0c1463ca33f7a562caba30311a008d7dc3eb036a170493188d7ab020019.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/980a08f6d9d01a6dd29b3f34b2378640e5661146c5e9131f95dc6d8bd4ed8d6b.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
